profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | TypeScript · React · Node.js | ~20 years building web apps end to end
profile.summary:
I build full-stack web applications end to end, from the database schema up through the server logic to the interface people actually touch. These days I work in TypeScript/JavaScript across the entire stack: React on the front end, Node.js and Express on the back end. I'm equally at home in the data layer, having shipped production work on MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB, with infrastructure running on Amazon Web Services. 

A lot of what I do lives at the integration layer, connecting applications to the services people already rely on. I've built integrations across video, social, and mapping platforms, and implemented secure online payment and credit card processing, turning third-party APIs into seamless parts of a single, cohesive product. My path into engineering ran through character animation and fine art, which is probably why I care how a thing feels to use as much as whether it works. 

With almost 20 years of full-stack experience behind me, what I enjoy most is owning the whole picture: making the architecture, the data, and the user experience work together so the final product feels effortless to use, which, as anyone who's built one knows, is the hardest kind of simple to pull off. 

Outside of client work, I'm a tinkerer: I build with Arduino and Raspberry Pi (lately a guitar that converts each string to MIDI in real time) and I fine-tune my own LLMs, partly to stay close to where software is heading, partly because I've never been much good at leaving a working system alone.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Joined Travelers as a front-end developer to build the customer-facing interface for a business insurance web portal, delivering the React and TypeScript front end through to launch. Then moved into the Work Orchestration team, where I built appetite tools: applications that help agents quickly determine whether a piece of business fits the company's underwriting appetite. Now contributing to a major new platform initiative.

Tech: TypeScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, AWS, Terraform, Claude.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Express.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MongoDB · JavaScript

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
As one half of a two-person development team, built web experiences for major media and entertainment clients including Disney, Marvel, TIME magazine, PBS Kids, and Pinna.fm, delivering engaging, interactive work for some of the most recognizable brands in publishing and children's media.

Tech: Laravel, WordPress, MySQL, AWS, React Native.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Worked across Betastream's own client projects and its subcontract development for digital agency Group SJR. On the company's own roster, built WordPress and WooCommerce storefronts with custom fulfillment integrations for direct-to-consumer food startups Daily Harvest and Freshly, connecting online ordering to the decidedly unglamorous logistics of getting a frozen meal to your door still frozen.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Delivered WordPress, Drupal, and Tumblr development, on schedule and to spec, for the agency's enterprise client roster: Barneys New York, General Electric, The Home Depot, the MPAA, Target, and Xerox. The work spoke for itself.

Tech: WordPress, Drupal, Objective C

positions.title: Freelance
positions.description: Designed and built WordPress sites for a range of clients including Widmer Brothers Brewing, the City of Kansas City, MO, and Tough Mudder, handling each project independently from concept to launch.

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
Built dynamic, engaging websites, primarily on WordPress with some Kohana work, for clients including Nike, National Geographic, the Portland Trail Blazers, Travel Oregon, and Timberline Lodge.

Tech: WordPress, PHP, Kohana, jQuery.

positions.title: PHP / MySQL Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained internal and customer-facing systems for a real-time marketing-leads provider, including the company intranet, affiliate program, and reseller interface. Modernized a legacy codebase by introducing the Zend and MooTools libraries, and produced supporting web and advertising assets (cutting designs to valid HTML).

Tech: LAMP stack, Zend Framework, MooTools.

positions.title: Instuctor
positions.description:
Taught the fundamentals of web design to students aged 10–17 in week-long courses at a technology-focused summer day camp. Each student finished the week with a personal website featuring custom graphics and either a Flash animation or a game they had programmed, with hand-coded HTML and CSS introduced as their skill level allowed. Flash was, at the time, a perfectly reasonable thing to bet a career on.

Tech: HTML, CSS, Flash. Tools: Dreamweaver, Photoshop.
